title: He founded a university that still runs today. Decades later, India gave him its highest civilian honor - after he was gone.
caption:
He founded a university that still runs today. Decades later, India gave him its highest civilian honor - after he was gone.

A freedom fighter, educationist and four-time president of the Indian National Congress, Malaviya is best remembered for founding Banaras Hindu University under the BHU Act of 1915 - and serving as its vice-chancellor from 1919 to 1938.

In 2014 - 68 years after his death - India posthumously awarded him the Bharat Ratna, its highest civilian honor, a day before what would have been his 153rd birth anniversary.

Malaviya didn't just campaign for independence - he built an institution that has educated generations since, long after the man himself was gone.
